name: Sentinel Hub EO Browser
description: High-resolution multi-spectral satellite imagery browser for Sentinel-1/2, Landsat, MODIS with custom band composites (NDVI, moisture, false color).

name: Google Earth Engine Timelapse
description: Global, zoomable time-lapse video tracking planetary changes from 1984 to the present day using satellite imagery.

name: NASA Worldview
description: Interactive daily global satellite imagery layers from NASA satellites within hours of acquisition, tracking smoke, dust, fires, and storms.

name: SunCalc
description: Sun position and shadow calculator for any time and location worldwide. Essential for shadow analysis and precise time verification.

name: PeakVisor
description: 3D mountain panorama simulation for identifying peaks and mountain horizons in photos and videos.

name: Overpass Turbo
description: Web-based data filtering tool for OpenStreetMap. Allows querying specific combinations of landmarks, road types, building heights, or infrastructure.

name: Mapillary
description: Crowdsourced, street-level imagery platform powered by computer vision. Useful in regions without official Google Street View coverage.

name: InVID-WeVerify Video Forensics
description: Verification toolbox to extract keyframes from web videos, reverse image search individual frames, analyze video metadata, and check video tampering.

name: ADS-B Exchange
description: Unfiltered flight tracking network that does not censor military, government, or private VIP aircraft movements.

name: Flightradar24
description: Global flight tracking service that provides real-time information about thousands of aircraft around the world.

name: MarineTraffic
description: Global vessel tracking intelligence using coastal AIS receivers and satellite tracking for ships, cargo carriers, and yachts.

name: VesselFinder
description: Free AIS vessel tracking service providing real-time positions, port calls, and historical vessel voyage data.

name: Internet Archive Wayback Machine
description: Digital archive of billions of web pages over time. Critical for recovering deleted evidence, historic posts, and modified articles.

name: Archive.today (archive.is)
description: Instant webpage snapshot archiver that stores text and graphic copies of a page permanently, bypassing paywalls and anti-bot checks.

name: OCCRP Aleph
description: Global archive of investigative documents, government gazettes, corporate registries, leaked datasets, and court records.

name: OpenSanctions
description: International database of politically exposed persons (PEPs), sanctioned individuals, and corporate entities subject to asset freezes.

name: OpenCorporates
description: Largest open database of corporate registry filings worldwide, linking directors, shareholder officers, and corporate hierarchies.

name: Live Universal Awareness Map (Liveuamap)
description: Real-time mapping of conflicts, military incidents, human rights emergencies, and security situations worldwide.

name: ACLED Conflict Data
description: Armed Conflict Location & Event Data Project collecting reported political violence and protest incidents across the globe.

name: Shodan
description: Search engine for Internet-connected devices, industrial control systems, webcams, servers, and network services.

name: Insecam
description: Directory of online live streaming cameras with geographical coordinates. Useful for real-time weather, crowd, or location checks.
